svg.aria-label: The lit-review mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake, citation verification: mark only or strict (stop); Literature strategist (agent); You review the sources: add or remove, optional (stop); Annotated bibliography, literature matrix, synthesis (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake agent: the draft and its questions, then config.md, DOI checking, the research question the run needs [D24, O, AD11, AV15]; a research report and its bibliography [AV1]; the profile [AV2]; a file in words [AQ] (stop); Session: the search themes, clusters of the method areas, each with its scope and target range, in config.md Decisions [The academic-paper strategist] (question); Literature strategist, theme run: search theme 1, review-theme-1.md and refs-theme-1.bib; each included source confirmed by a live lookup, an unconfirmed one excluded and listed [The academic-paper strategist] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme runs: each other search theme, all at once [The academic-paper strategist] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, merge jobs, all at once: a leads job per theme run, the intersections and the venues [CA], the first citation round [The lit-review run under the rules] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, citation rounds over the merged core set [CA]: refs and cited-by jobs of at most 40 works, until the loop closes, at most 8 [The lit-review run under the rules] (ruled, only when needed); The citation loop does not close: the works not collected and the rounds run; another 8 rounds, or go on with the works named [The lit-review run under the rules] (stop); Literature strategist, merge run, fresh: the duplicates removed, the report over the merged set, the gates computed, a gate's search a job the session starts; the annotations joined with cat into review.md [CA] [The lit-review run under the rules] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, synthesis start: the section Synthesis Analysis of review.md, its counts from counts-merge.md [The lit-review run under the rules] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist: review.md, refs.bib; a list over 50 entries shows its first 20 and last 5; it does not start without a research question [D2, AD11, AV15, AV16] (ruled, only when needed); The strategist, one search theme: each included source confirmed by a live lookup, an unconfirmed one excluded and listed [The academic-paper strategist] (ruled); Session: each theme run's report read as it ends, or the one strategist's, for work of its prompt or its page left undone [The academic-paper strategist] (question); Script, run by the session: one lookup.py resolve per .bib of a theme run or merge job, or refs.bib for one theme; a proceedings page for an entry with neither; checks.md [The academic-paper strategist] [The lit-review run under the rules] (script); Literature strategist, resumed with checks.md: the differing titles resolved; strict: a failing identifier corrected or removed, once [O] [The academic-paper strategist] (ruled); Session: the merge run's report read, or the one strategist's, for sources or leads not assessed and items of its prompt not done [The academic-paper strategist] (question); Script, run by the session: lookup.py resolve once over every entry of refs.bib, no identifier or title under two keys, the cited keys equal to the .bib's, into checks.md [The academic-paper strategist] (script); Session: the exclusions read; one made on a failed lookup is work left undone [The academic-paper strategist] (question); You review the sources: add or remove, optional [J] (stop); Script, run by the session: lookup.py resolve again on each corrected or added entry's DOI or arXiv ID, into checks.md [O] [The academic-paper strategist] (script); A reference that cannot be confirmed [O] (stop); Formatter: each target other than Markdown, from review.md with refs.bib; the review's issues to the merge run, or to the synthesis start for its section, then the targets again [The academic-paper strategist] [The lit-review run under the rules] (ruled, only when needed); End (agent); At every patch: a structural patch, a patch that does not apply (retry as often as you ask, write it again in full, or leave it [BR]), a script failed [C] (stop).
